$comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories with no resolvable version in range. `bun run audit` fails only on advisories absent from this list. Regenerate with `bun run audit:baseline` and justify each new entry.

entries.title: brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups
entries.note: Dev-only: reached via eslint > @eslint/eslintrc > minimatch and eslint-config-next > typescript-eslint. Not in the production bundle. The DoS needs an attacker-supplied glob; the only patterns are our own eslint config. Pinned by eslint's range — unfixable until eslint bumps.

entries.title: flatted vulnerable to unbounded recursion DoS in parse() revive phase
entries.note: Dev-only: eslint's cache serialization. Parses only eslint's own cache file on this machine, never untrusted input. Not in the production bundle.

entries.title: Prototype Pollution via parse() in NodeJS flatted
entries.note: Dev-only: same eslint cache path as GHSA-25h7-pfq9-p65f. No untrusted input reaches parse(). Not in the production bundle.

entries.title: minimatch ReDoS: nested *() extglobs generate catastrophically backtracking regular expressions
entries.note: Dev-only: eslint file matching. Patterns come from our own eslint config, not from user input. Pinned by eslint's range.

entries.title: minimatch has a ReDoS via repeated wildcards with non-matching literal in pattern
entries.note: Dev-only: same eslint matching path as GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74. No attacker-controlled glob.

entries.title: minimatch has ReDoS: matchOne() combinatorial backtracking via multiple non-adjacent GLOBSTAR segments
entries.note: Dev-only: same eslint matching path as GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74. No attacker-controlled glob.

entries.title: Picomatch has a ReDoS vulnerability via extglob quantifiers
entries.note: Dev-only: eslint-config-next > typescript-eslint > tinyglobby > fdir > picomatch. Lint-time file discovery only. Not in the production bundle.

entries.title: sharp inherited vulnerabilities in libvips: CVE-2026-33327, CVE-2026-33328, CVE-2026-35590, CVE-2026-35591
entries.note: RUNTIME dependency (next > sharp) — the only entry here that is not dev-only. Exploitation requires optimizing a malicious image. next.config.ts declares no images.remotePatterns, so Next refuses to optimize remote URLs, and the site has no upload path: every image sharp sees is committed to /public by us. Next pins sharp at ^0.34.5, so 0.35.0 is out of range and unfixable here. RE-EVALUATE if remotePatterns is ever added or user uploads are introduced. Dependabot will surface the Next bump that resolves this.
